items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee only responds with 'Yeah' and 'Absolutely' to the interviewer's statements about Huby Blake; no personal interaction or relationship is described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: That I‟m told is really… as a matter of fact Huby said that that really was… he used as his model many of those older musicians like [Unintelligible] and the Cleff Club people and stuff like that.
